name: Jayant Infratech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2003, Jayant Infratech Ltd undertakes Railway Electrification & Infrastructure projects[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
JIL is a technology driven company with expertise in Railway Electrification & Infrastructure Projects. Company does electrification of new & existing Railway tracks and provides concept to commissioning of Railway Infrastructure from design to energization. Company has completed several KMS of electrification and has erected many traction substation. It specializes in design, drawing, supply, erection, and commissioning of 25KV, 50Hz Single Phase Traction Overhead Equipment for electrification of new and existing railway tracks

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 44.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -3.90%
